verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.counterexample_blocks_universal
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {P : α → Prop}, (∃ x, ¬P x) → ¬∀ (x : α), P x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.exists_and_counterexample_blocks_forall
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {P : α → Prop}, (∃ x, P x) → (∃ x, ¬P x) → (∃ x, P x) ∧ ¬∀ (x : α), P x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.finite_prefix_does_not_imply_global_bool
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), ∃ s, (∀ n ≤ N, s n = false) ∧ ∃ n, s n = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.verifiedRelation_holds
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} {R : α → β → Prop} (v : MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.VerifiedRelation α β R), R v.input v.output

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.verifiedWitness_nonempty
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {P : α → Prop}, MCore.CertifiedFirewalls.VerifiedWitness α P → ∃ x, P x
